method_note: Each lever is compared with the other lines in the same ad and slot. Lines aren't randomised and levers overlap, so every finding below is a test to run, not a proof. Google returned NOT_APPLICABLE as every line's performance label, so the labels are not used. Near-duplicate variants of a line (case, spacing or punctuation only) are merged and count as one line. Cue words were read, not just matched: the overruled ones are listed below.
